productDetails.heading: Thoughtfully Woven for Everyday Living
productDetails.description: Made from natural rattan and shaped with a traditional circular weave, each coaster brings an inviting handcrafted touch to the table. The included holder keeps the six-piece set neatly together.

story.headline: Vietnamese Craftsmanship, Natural Living
story.body: MAYTREDAN celebrates the beauty of Vietnamese weaving traditions through practical home essentials. We pair natural materials with thoughtful, understated design to bring warmth and character into modern living spaces.

lifestyle.heading: The Small Details Make a Space Feel Like Home
lifestyle.body: Style your coffee corner, dining table or afternoon tea setting with the relaxed charm of natural rattan.

gifting.heading: A Thoughtful Gift for a Cozy Home
gifting.body: A useful, decorative set for housewarmings, birthdays and everyday celebrations.

care.heading: Simple Care for Natural Rattan
steps: Gently wipe with a slightly damp cloth.
Do not soak or immerse in water.
Allow to dry completely before storing.
Keep in a clean, dry, well-ventilated place.

faq.q: What is included in the set?
faq.a: Six handmade rattan coasters and one matching holder.
Approximately 4 inches (10 cm) across. Because each piece is handwoven, slight variations may occur.
Natural rattan and handmade weaving can result in subtle differences in shade and woven details.
